elements_selected.content: Extend zetl check to validate all source metadata references as static validation errors per REQ-042 and CON-004 extended. After extraction (task-source-extraction) and resolution infrastructure (task-blockid-resolution, task-hash-prefix-resolution): run validate_source_refs(spl_blocks, vault_hash_index) which for each ExplicitGrounding: 1) Attempt to resolve each source_ref, 2) Hash ref resolves to zero leaves → spl_diagnostics error: 'content hash X not found — source content may have been modified or removed', 3) Hash ref prefix ambiguous (different full hashes) → spl_diagnostics error: 'ambiguous hash prefix X — use a longer prefix', 4) Hash ref with duplicate content (identical full hashes) → valid, no error, 5) ^block-id not found in file → spl_diagnostics error: 'source references ^X which does not exist in this file', 6) [[Page]] not found → spl_diagnostics error: 'page Page not found', 7) [[Page^block-id]] block-id not found in page → spl_diagnostics error: 'block-id not found in Page'. Report in spl_diagnostics (not drift_diagnostics). These are static errors, not temporal drift. Wire into cmd_check in main.rs. No --fail-on changes needed — source validation errors use the existing spl error level.
